This was a big, green, '''hairy plant''' with claws encountered by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were stranded on a [[Unidentified planet (space crystals)|planet]] after their [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|space vessel]] needed a new supply of [[space crystal]]s. While looking for a cave containing replacement crystals, they crossed a slimy [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]], where C-3PO lifted a rock in an attempt to find the entrance to the cave. However, beneath the rock grew a large plant with claws. Then both droids hurried away.<ref name="Shiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Perhaps the entrance to the cave is beneath this rock|C-3PO in ''Shiny as a Droid'', addressing the reader|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
The plant appeared in [[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Shiny as a Droid'']], a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]]. The image of the plant was hidden behind a flap, and to see what was inside, it had to be opened.<ref name="Shiny" />
